name: Jerez de la Frontera (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Jerez de la Frontera (waves on blue within a bordure of castles and lions).
history: Municipal flag of Jerez de la Frontera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Jerez de la Frontera arms — waves within a bordure of castles and lions
